title: Publish benchmark report PDF + figure assets (Latency/$ report)
author: Wei Chen
description:
Publishes the benchmark report PDF artifact and the supporting figure assets used by the landing page + blog. This PR is intentionally content/packaging only (no benchmark numbers or methodology changes). It adds the final PDF under /static with a stable public URL, adds optimized PNG/SVG figures for the web version, and updates the landing page + press kit links to point at the shipped asset paths. CI gates in this repo already enforce link integrity and asset size limits; this PR includes small tweaks to keep us under the budget (PDF compression + image optimization) and to avoid broken anchors in the generated PDF link.

What’s included: (1) /benchmarks/latency-per-dollar report PDF (final layout from Marketing/Design) (2) figure exports (heatmaps, latency/$ by model+region, p95 latency chart, $/1M tokens bar) in web-friendly formats (3) landing page updates to add a direct “Download PDF” CTA and checksum note (4) press kit download links updated to the same canonical file.

Notes / constraints: The PDF is served as a static asset by the docs site CDN. Keep file size < 10MB and individual images < 1.5MB to avoid build-time and runtime regressions. If we need to publish an updated PDF later (v1.1), do not overwrite the file in-place; add a versioned filename and update links (Legal requested we keep the exact artifact behind any public claim).
commits: Add final benchmark report PDF to static assets (versioned filename)
Add optimized figure exports (png/svg) for landing page + blog
Update landing page copy to link PDF + add footnote disclaimer reference
Fix link checker false positives for static PDF anchor patterns
Compress large images and normalize naming conventions for figures
